card.name: Linking words before colonial-era wars
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, in, of, during) just before a named 18th-century war, treaty or college, such as the French and Indian War, American Revolution, Treaty of Paris, or College of William and Mary.

modes.label: Before a war name
modes.description: A linking word like in, the or during comes right before a colonial-era war or revolution.
modes.example: he entered military service, seeing action in<< the>> French and Indian War, where he served

modes.label: Inside treaty or college names
modes.description: The word of inside a name such as Treaty of Paris or College of William and Mary.
modes.example: After the Treaty<< of>> Paris ended French imperial claims in North America

card.writes: It pushes toward words from the Enlightenment and revolutionary era, and away from photograph words.
